title: Repurposing PeTriBERT for Protein Protein Interaction Prediction with Sequence Structure Fusion
authors: Arthur Wavreille; Gabriel Krouk; Baldwin Dumortier
one_liner_zh: 该文将逆折叠编码器PeTriBERT与ESM-2序列嵌入融合，用于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用预测，属于蛋白质结构相关计算建模的工程应用，方法有一定创新但问题聚焦于PPI预测而非结构生成/采样。
abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence have enabled models to capture protein sequence and structural features. We present PeTriPPI2, a hybrid framework for protein--protein interaction (PPI) prediction that combines sequence embeddings from ESM-2 with structural representations from PeTriBERT, an encoder originally designed for inverse folding. We evaluate this sequence--structure approach on the Pinder dataset. On a test set of 2,342 protein pairs, the selected checkpoint achieves 0.898 accuracy, 0.917 precision, 0.876 recall, and 0.896 F1 score for the interacting class (AUROC 0.963). Compared with SpatialPPIv2 on the same test data, PeTriPPI2 has higher precision (0.917 versus 0.886) but lower recall (0.876 versus 0.942) and F1 score (0.896 versus 0.913). Component ablations indicate that both the sequence and structural pathways contribute to this configuration.
abstract_zh: 人工智能的最新进展使模型能够捕捉蛋白质序列和结构特征。我们提出了PeTriPPI2，一个用于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）预测的混合框架，它结合了来自ESM-2的序列嵌入与来自PeTriBERT的结构表示，后者是一种最初为逆折叠设计的编码器。我们在Pinder数据集上评估了这种序列-结构方法。在一个包含2,342对蛋白质的测试集上，所选检查点对于相互作用类别达到了0.898的准确率、0.917的精确率、0.876的召回率和0.896的F1分数（AUROC为0.963）。与同一测试数据上的SpatialPPIv2相比，PeTriPPI2具有更高的精确率（0.917对0.886），但召回率（0.876对0.942）和F1分数（0.896对0.913）较低。组件消融实验表明，序列和结构通路均对该配置有所贡献。
